title: Why your small business needs a missed call solution
summary: The majority of callers won't try you again after a missed call. Here's how to prevent missed calls with the right tools and setup.
body_markdown: Quo’s business phone system lets you set up custom auto-replies for missed calls, voicemails, and text messages. You can also set auto-replies based on your business hours, with different messages for during work hours and after you close. Not sure if Quo is right for you? Read our roundup of the best[missed call text back software](https://www.quo.com/blog/missed-call-text-back-software/) .
